$comment: Duplicate-code gate (docs/ENGINEERING.md §3.3): ≥ 5 lines / 50 tokens duplicated anywhere in package source fails `./validate.sh duplication`. Tests, builders and scenario tables may repeat setup (the gameplay framework under testing/gameplay is measured); generated and third-party output is not ours. Any clone fails through exitCode (#98): threshold compares a percentage rounded to two decimals, so a small clone in a large codebase reads 0.00% and passes it.
